Patch Set 13:

Thanks for this - 88828 (the Redfish ComponentIntegrity frontend) depends on the certificate object this change publishes, so I dug into why CI is red and wanted to share what I found, plus offer to help.

1. The immediate CI failure is format-code.sh, not a build error. It halts before the build with a clang-format diff on requester/component_integrity_dbus.cpp - two wrapped statements the current clang-format wants on one line each:
   - std::string chassisId = sdbusplus::object_path(path).filename();
   - the co_return std::make_tuple(...) in the catch block
   Running format-code.sh (or the W26 clang-format) and amending clears it.

2. Behind that, PS13 looks stale against current master and no longer cherry-picks cleanly - conflicts in requester/component_integrity_dbus.cpp / .hpp, meson.build, and tests/meson.build. The trickiest is tests/test_component_integrity.cpp, which was deleted on master but is still modified here, so a rebase has to decide whether to drop those test changes or re-home them.

3. After a rebase + format, it'll hit the current sdbusplus drift on master. requester/utils/mapper.cpp (ObjectMapper get_sub_tree_t removed) and requester/tcp_transport_discovery.cpp (sdbusplus::match_rules -> sdbusplus::bus::match::rules) no longer compile against today's sdbusplus - I've put a fix up as 91656 ("requester: fix build against current sdbusplus", verified 857/857 + tests in the W26 dmtf-libspdm container); landing that first should get master green under this change.

Happy to help however is useful - I can push the clang-format fix as a patchset, or pair on the rebase. The deleted-test_component_integrity.cpp call is yours since it's your test coverage. Let me know.

Patch Set 13:

Correction to my earlier comment -- please disregard point 3.

There is no sdbusplus drift. spdm main (eae7d72, "sdbusplus: use shorter type aliases") builds against current sdbusplus in CI, and both Mapper::get_sub_tree_t and sdbusplus::match_rules are present -- not removed. That "failure" was an artifact of my local tree: a stale vendored subprojects/sdbusplus pinned at an Apr-9 revision (before match_rules landed) that meson reused instead of fetching revision=HEAD.

I've abandoned 91656 accordingly -- it wasn't needed, and it actually reverted the shorter-aliases migration.

Points 1 (clang-format on component_integrity_dbus.cpp) and 2 (stale rebase / the deleted tests/test_component_integrity.cpp) still stand. Apologies for the noise in point 3.
